headline: Windward Acquires Azimut.ai to Expand Maritime Visual Intelligence
summary: Windward acquired Azimut.ai to add a sensing layer that identifies and fingerprints vessels in real time at maritime chokepoints and ports, enabling visibility even when vessels go dark.
why: Strategic acquisitions in specialized artificial intelligence and maritime tracking allow software firms to expand their product capabilities and tap into defense and supply chain monitoring markets.
